audit_status.source_base: Greek Galatians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for freedom, circumcision warning, trust working through love, Spirit versus flesh-pattern, love of neighbor, works of flesh and fruit of Spirit.

verses.restored: For freedom Messiah set us free; stand firm therefore and do not be held again in a yoke of slavery.

familiar.text: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

modern.text: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery.

original.text: τῇ ἐλευθερίᾳ ⸂ἡμᾶς Χριστὸς ἠλευθέρωσεν· στήκετε οὖν⸃ καὶ μὴ πάλιν ζυγῷ δουλείας ἐνέχεσθε.

verses.restored: Look, I Paul say to you that if you receive circumcision, Messiah will benefit you nothing.

familiar.text: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

modern.text: Take notice: I, Paul, tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no value to you at all.

original.text: Ἴδε ἐγὼ Παῦλος λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν περιτέμνησθε Χριστὸς ὑμᾶς οὐδὲν ὠφελήσει.

verses.restored: And I testify again to every human receiving circumcision that one is obligated to do the whole Law.

familiar.text: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

modern.text: Again I testify to every man who gets himself circumcised that he is obligated to obey the whole law.

original.text: μαρτύρομαι δὲ πάλιν παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ περιτεμνομένῳ ὅτι ὀφειλέτης ἐστὶν ὅλον τὸν νόμον ποιῆσαι.

verses.restored: You were made inactive from Messiah, whoever are being made righteous/just by Law; you fell from grace.

familiar.text: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.

modern.text: You who are trying to be justified by the law have been severed from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.

original.text: κατηργήθητε ⸀ἀπὸ Χριστοῦ οἵτινες ἐν νόμῳ δικαιοῦσθε, τῆς χάριτος ἐξεπέσατε.

verses.restored: For we, by Spirit, from trust, eagerly await the hope of righteousness/justice.

familiar.text: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

modern.text: But by faith we eagerly await through the Spirit the hope of righteousness.

original.text: ἡμεῖς γὰρ πνεύματι ἐκ πίστεως ἐλπίδα δικαιοσύνης ἀπεκδεχόμεθα.

verses.restored: For in Messiah Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any strength, but trust working through love.

familiar.text: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

modern.text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. All that matters is faith, expressed through love.

original.text: ἐν γὰρ Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ οὔτε περιτομή τι ἰσχύει οὔτε ἀκροβυστία, ἀλλὰ πίστις διʼ ἀγάπης ἐνεργουμένη.

verses.restored: You were running beautifully/well; who hindered you from being persuaded by the truth?

familiar.text: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

modern.text: You were running so well. Who has obstructed you from obeying the truth?

original.text: Ἐτρέχετε καλῶς· τίς ὑμᾶς ἐνέκοψεν ⸀τῇ ἀληθείᾳ μὴ πείθεσθαι;

verses.restored: This persuasion is not from the One calling you.

familiar.text: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.

modern.text: Such persuasion does not come from the One who calls you.

original.text: ἡ πεισμονὴ οὐκ ἐκ τοῦ καλοῦντος ὑμᾶς.

verses.restored: A little leaven leavens the whole lump.

familiar.text: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

modern.text: A little leaven works through the whole batch of dough.

original.text: μικρὰ ζύμη ὅλον τὸ φύραμα ζυμοῖ.

verses.restored: I am persuaded about you in the Lord that you will think nothing otherwise; but the one troubling you will bear the judgment, whoever that may be.

familiar.text: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

modern.text: I am confident in the Lord that you will take no other view. The one who is troubling you will bear the judgment, whoever he may be.

original.text: ἐγὼ πέποιθα εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐν κυρίῳ ὅτι οὐδὲν ἄλλο φρονήσετε· ὁ δὲ ταράσσων ὑμᾶς βαστάσει τὸ κρίμα, ὅστις ⸀ἐὰν ᾖ.

verses.restored: But I, siblings, if I still proclaim circumcision, why am I still pursued/persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been made inactive.

familiar.text: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.

modern.text: Now, brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case the offense of the cross has been abolished.

original.text: ἐγὼ δέ, ἀδελφοί, εἰ περιτομὴν ἔτι κηρύσσω, τί ἔτι διώκομαι; ἄρα κατήργηται τὸ σκάνδαλον τοῦ σταυροῦ.

verses.restored: Would that those unsettling you would even cut themselves off.

familiar.text: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.

modern.text: As for those who are agitating you, I wish they would proceed to emasculate themselves!

original.text: ὄφελον καὶ ἀποκόψονται οἱ ἀναστατοῦντες ὑμᾶς.

verses.restored: For you were called to freedom, siblings; only not freedom as a starting point for flesh, but through love serve one another.

familiar.text: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

modern.text: For you, brothers, were called to freedom; but do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh. Rather, serve one another in love.

original.text: Ὑμεῖς γὰρ ἐπʼ ἐλευθερίᾳ ἐκλήθητε, ἀδελφοί· μόνον μὴ τὴν ἐλευθερίαν εἰς ἀφορμὴν τῇ σαρκί, ἀλλὰ διὰ τῆς ἀγάπης δουλεύετε ἀλλήλοις·

verses.restored: For the whole Law has been fulfilled in one word, in this: You shall love your neighbor as yourself.

familiar.text: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

modern.text: The entire law is fulfilled in a single decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”

original.text: ὁ γὰρ πᾶς νόμος ἐν ἑνὶ λόγῳ ⸀πεπλήρωται, ἐν τῷ· Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς ⸀σεαυτόν.

verses.restored: But if you bite and devour one another, watch lest you be consumed by one another.

familiar.text: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

modern.text: But if you keep on biting and devouring one another, watch out, or you will be consumed by one another. Walking by the Spirit (Ezekiel 36:16–38; Romans 8:9–11)

original.text: εἰ δὲ ἀλλήλους δάκνετε καὶ κατεσθίετε, βλέπετε μὴ ὑπʼ ἀλλήλων ἀναλωθῆτε.

verses.restored: But I say: walk by Spirit, and you will certainly not complete the desire of flesh.

familiar.text: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

modern.text: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

original.text: Λέγω δέ, πνεύματι περιπατεῖτε καὶ ἐπιθυμίαν σαρκὸς οὐ μὴ τελέσητε.

verses.restored: For the flesh desires against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; for these are opposed to one another, so that you may not do whatever you want.

familiar.text: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

modern.text: For the flesh craves what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are opposed to each other, so that you do not do what you want.

original.text: ἡ γὰρ σὰρξ ἐπιθυμεῖ κατὰ τοῦ πνεύματος, τὸ δὲ πνεῦμα κατὰ τῆς σαρκός, ταῦτα ⸀γὰρ ⸂ἀλλήλοις ἀντίκειται⸃, ἵνα μὴ ἃ ⸀ἐὰν θέλητε ταῦτα ποιῆτε.

verses.restored: But if you are led by Spirit, you are not under Law.

familiar.text: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

modern.text: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

original.text: εἰ δὲ πνεύματι ἄγεσθε, οὐκ ἐστὲ ὑπὸ νόμον.

verses.restored: Now manifest are the works of the flesh: sexual immorality/misuse, uncleanness, shameless excess,

familiar.text: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

modern.text: The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery;

original.text: φανερὰ δέ ἐστιν τὰ ἔργα τῆς σαρκός, ἅτινά ⸀ἐστιν πορνεία, ἀκαθαρσία, ἀσέλγεια,

verses.restored: idolatry, sorcery, enmities, strife, jealousy, angers, selfish ambitions, dissensions, factions,

familiar.text: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

modern.text: idolatry and sorcery; hatred, discord, jealousy, and rage; rivalries, divisions, factions,

original.text: εἰδωλολατρία, φαρμακεία, ἔχθραι, ⸂ἔρις, ζῆλος⸃, θυμοί, ἐριθεῖαι, διχοστασίαι, αἱρέσεις,

verses.restored: envies, drunkennesses, revelries, and things like these, which I tell you beforehand, as I said before, that those practicing such things will not inherit the reign of the Divine.

familiar.text: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

modern.text: and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. I warn you, as I did before, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.

original.text: ⸀φθόνοι, μέθαι, κῶμοι, καὶ τὰ ὅμοια τούτοις, ἃ προλέγω ὑμῖν ⸀καθὼς προεῖπον ὅτι οἱ τὰ τοιαῦτα πράσσοντες βασιλείαν θεοῦ οὐ κληρονομήσουσιν.

verses.restored: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness/trust,

familiar.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

modern.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

original.text: Ὁ δὲ καρπὸς τοῦ πνεύματός ἐστιν ἀγάπη, χαρά, εἰρήνη, μακροθυμία, χρηστότης, ἀγαθωσύνη, πίστις,

verses.restored: gentleness, self-control; against such things there is no Law.

familiar.text: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

modern.text: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

original.text: πραΰτης, ἐγκράτεια· κατὰ τῶν τοιούτων οὐκ ἔστιν νόμος.

verses.restored: But those of Messiah Jesus crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.

familiar.text: And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

modern.text: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.

original.text: οἱ δὲ τοῦ ⸀Χριστοῦ τὴν σάρκα ἐσταύρωσαν σὺν τοῖς παθήμασιν καὶ ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις.

verses.restored: If we live by Spirit, let us also walk in line by Spirit.

familiar.text: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

modern.text: Since we live by the Spirit, let us walk in step with the Spirit.

original.text: εἰ ζῶμεν πνεύματι, πνεύματι καὶ στοιχῶμεν.

verses.restored: Let us not become empty-glorious, provoking one another, envying one another.

familiar.text: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

modern.text: Let us not become conceited, provoking and envying one another.

original.text: μὴ γινώμεθα κενόδοξοι, ἀλλήλους προκαλούμενοι, ἀλλήλοις φθονοῦντες.

translation_notes: Galatians 5:6 is a key anchor: neither circumcision nor uncircumcision, but trust working through love.
Freedom is not license for flesh-pattern; it becomes loving service.
Works of flesh are patterns of destructive desire and community fracture, not a condemnation of embodiment itself.
